TCS to hire 80% workforce with digital, AI skills

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) plans to hire 80% of its workforce with digital and artificial intelligence (AI) skills, expecting this to support profitability as AI deals grow. The company stated that US green card curbs are not expected to have a major impact on its operations. TCS anticipates margin gains from this hiring strategy.
